editorial:
Imagine being a homeless ex-soldier hiding on the streets of London, running from your past. That is exactly where Joey Jones finds himself at the start of this gritty thriller. After a violent encounter, he stumbles into an empty luxury apartment and decides to borrow its owner's identity. What follows is a dark, emotional journey as Joey uses his new life to hunt down the people who hurt a young woman he cares about, while also trying to reconnect with his estranged daughter. The movie feels grounded and raw, with a moody London backdrop that adds real weight to every scene. Jason Statham delivers one of his most layered performances here, showing vulnerability alongside his usual tough-guy energy.

The action is sharp but never over the top, and the pacing keeps you invested from start to finish. On the downside, some plot threads feel rushed, and the romance subplot does not always land. Still, if you enjoy character-driven thrillers with heart, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Joey tracks down the men responsible for the young woman's death and takes brutal revenge. He also confronts his own guilt over a past military mistake. After settling his debts, Joey realizes he cannot keep living a lie. He leaves the stolen identity behind, walks away from the luxury apartment, and returns to the streets, choosing honesty over comfort. The movie ends with him finding a small measure of peace, having protected those he loves while accepting that redemption comes with sacrifice.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character-driven action thrillers with heart.
